# NFL Daily — 2026-07-29 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 07/28: Eagles make DT Jalen Carter the NFL's highest-paid interior defender with a 4-year, $152M extension ($106M guaranteed). [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7475346/2026/07/28/eagles-jalen-carter-contract-extension/)
- 07/28: Browns sign CB Denzel Ward to a 2-year, $62.2M extension, making him the NFL's highest-paid DB again. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/denzel-ward-agrees-to-extension-browns-highest-paid-db-in-nfl-history/)

- 07/28: Steelers QB Aaron Rodgers says 2026 will be his final NFL season. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/07/steelers-aaron-rodgers-explains-why-2026-will-be-his-final-nfl-season.html)

- 07/29: Falcons RB Bijan Robinson and Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs both sit out practice amid ongoing talks for new long-term contracts. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7477519/2026/07/29/lions-jahmyr-gibbs-falcons-bijan-robinson-contracts/)
- 07/29: Bengals 2025 first-round DE Shemar Stewart carted off during 11-on-11 drills on the first day of camp. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7477572/2026/07/29/shemar-stewart-bengals-injury/)

- 07/28: Bears DE Montez Sweat placed on the NFI list with a short-term illness, expected back soon. [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2082196615520022934)
